# Seasons and market rhythm (generated)

Source: `SEASON_PEAK`, `SEASON_AMPLITUDE`, `seasonMul`, `SEASONS`, `seasonOf`, `DEMAND_SCALE`, `NEEDS_MUL`, `MAKES_MUL` in `src/sim/market.mjs`. Type of data: game design values (assumed).

## Production seasons

A listed good produces `1 + SEASON_AMPLITUDE x cos(2 pi x (day - peak) / 365)` times its normal rate (`seasonMul`): 1.35x at its peak day, 0.65x half a year away, 1.0 on average over the year. A good not listed produces at the same rate all year (`seasonMul` returns 1). Day 0 is 1 January.

| Good | Peak day of the year | Peak date |
| --- | --- | --- |
| grain | 225 | 14 August |
| wine | 270 | 28 September |
| olive_oil | 330 | 27 November |
| sugar | 100 | 11 April |
| pepper | 150 | 31 May |
| wool | 150 | 31 May |
| fish | 110 | 21 April |
| salt | 200 | 20 July |

## Calendar seasons

`seasonOf(day)` maps the day to one of winter, spring, summer, autumn (`SEASONS`), quarter-years with an 11-day offset: day 0 (1 January) is winter, and winter starts again on day 354 (about 21 December).

## Daily demand rhythm

Each day a city wants `DEMAND_SCALE` (3) times the per-1000 rate of the [goods table](goods.md) for every good, times `NEEDS_MUL` (3) when the city needs the good, times `MAKES_MUL` (0.3) when it makes the good itself (local supply, no freight). Citizens buy by class and drop out above their tolerance ([classes table](classes.md)).
